description: List and search Grok Build sessions from the local store ($GROK_HOME/sessions). Search is local-only: it does not consult `grok sessions search` or any remote index. Pass `id` for a single session, `query` for a case-insensitive substring over title, first prompt, and id, and `cwd` to keep only sessions that started in that directory. A reported id resumes from any directory with `grok -r <id>` or the grok tool's `resume` argument.

inputSchema.description: List or inspect local Grok Build sessions.

cwd.description: Keep only sessions that *started* in this directory. Resume still works from anywhere (`grok -r <id>`).

id.description: Exact session id lookup. Ignores query, cwd, and limit. Falls back to a case-insensitive match.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return. Default 20. Ignored when `id` is set.

query.description: Case-insensitive substring over title, first prompt, and id. Search is local-only: it does not consult `grok sessions search` or any remote index.

inputSchema.title: SessionsInput

name: sessions
title: List Grok sessions
